ns2:course.label: Mechanisms Viral Pathogenesis
ns2:course.description: Lecture-discussion on topics of molecular mechanisms of viral pathogenesis. Mechanisms of infection, virulence, viral spread, interaction with the immune system, persistence and other host-parasite relationships are covered using modern literature and in depth exploration of several animal virus systems. Same as MCB 561. Prerequisite: MCB 430 and either MCB 433 or VP 637; MCB 350, MCB 452 or MCB 453; consent of instructor.
